notes.title: European Game Showcase
notes.content:
European Game Showcase

We have exciting news to share today!

Replaceable was selected by the European Game Showcase to be presented during GDC. On the 19th of March we will showcase the current status and future vision of our game to the press, publishers and strategic partners.

Shout out to our entire GAME.PACK
With the support of Vlaams Audiovisueel Fonds and Wallimage

Check out our latest teaser here.
